name: obedient-ai
description: Loads standing rules at session start, guards against dangerous git, foreground sleeps and pip install, and ships the polish, learn-logs, marketing and post skills.

token-saver.description: Saves tokens: runs short git prompts without a model turn, trims wasteful Reads and repeat errors, offers a fresh start on unrelated tasks, and can keep the prompt cache warm. Each part has its own switch.

isQuickOn.title: Run commit, merge, push and other short prompts without the model
isQuickOn.description: Commit, merge, push, pull, release, test, run, stop and deploy run directly when the prompt is only that command.

isTrimOn.title: Trim wasteful Reads, repeat errors and repeat Bash
isTrimOn.description: Blocks duplicate and missing-file Reads, caps big Reads, downscales large images, and warns on repeat errors and repeat Bash.

isNudgeOn.title: Offer a fresh start on an unrelated task in a big session
isNudgeOn.description: Asks whether to start fresh or compact when a new, unrelated prompt arrives in a session over 150k tokens.

isCacheKeeperOn.title: Keep the prompt cache warm (each ping spends tokens)
isCacheKeeperOn.description: Sends a one-word ping when the session is idle, then compacts. Each ping spends tokens.

commitModel.title: Commit message model
commitModel.description: Alias or model id used through the session's own API client.

intervalMinutes.title: Idle minutes before each keep-alive step
intervalMinutes.description: Cache TTL minus a margin: 55 for the 1-hour TTL, 4 for the 5-minute TTL.

maxPings.title: Keep-alive pings before compacting
maxPings.description: Pings sent while idle; the next idle step compacts.

minTokens.title: Minimum context tokens for the keep-alive
minTokens.description: Sessions smaller than this are left alone.
